info.title: Mockfly Public API
info.summary: Manage Mockfly mock projects, endpoints and responses programmatically.
info.description:
REST API to manage your [Mockfly](https://mockfly.dev) mock API projects programmatically: create a project from a script, import a whole project from your CI pipeline, or keep your mocks in sync with your codebase without opening the dashboard.

Authentication uses your **account API key** (`mf_…`), sent as the **raw** value of the `Authorization` header (there is no `Bearer` prefix). The same key covers every operation (projects, endpoints and responses) on every project the account is a member of.

The API Hub catalog (`GET /hub/catalog`) is completely open and needs no key.

---

**Maintenance note:** this specification is maintained by hand in the [`mockfly-page`](https://github.com/zamarrowski/mockfly-page) repository (`public/openapi.json`); it is not generated from the backend. The functional source of truth is the [Public API documentation](https://mockfly.dev/docs/public-api/), so if the two ever disagree, trust the docs and please [open an issue](https://github.com/zamarrowski/mockfly-page/issues).
